dialogue.text: Jory: I used to carry passengers. Now I carry what they cannot say to each other.

description: A sailor who once carried passengers now carries their letters. His attention is to getting people news and a means to answer, not discovering the contents for himself.

links.description: Carries letters from Irena’s daughter inland. His watch is about to start, so he entrusts this sealed envelope to the child and immediately reassures them that the daughter is alive. She pays for a reply before writing her own letter.
Quoted dialogue: Before offering the letter.

name: Jory
